name: transporter 1, ATP binding cassette subfamily B member

function.text: TAP1 encodes antigen peptide transporter 1. Annotated molecular activities include ATP hydrolysis activity and protein homodimerization activity. It participates in defense response and peptide transport.

germline.text: Strong or definitive GenCC assertions link constitutional variants to MHC class I deficiency (autosomal recessive); MHC class I deficiency 1 (autosomal recessive).

somatic.text: This gene is included in cancer-panel definitions, but a disease-specific somatic association has not been assigned from the alteration-context sources reviewed for this draft.

germline_associations.mechanism: Autosomal recessive; definitive GenCC assertion from ClinGen. Allele-specific mechanism requires review.
